hero_description: I built all of it. He asks if it's [cool](/cool). I don't ask.
about_me_paragraph_1: I'm the software engineer. TypeScript is my main thing. I build the web apps and I'm the one messing with AI. When the infra breaks, that's me too. He fixes it.
about_me_paragraph_2: When he's not coding he [thinks](/thinking) about random stuff until it turns into excalidraws. I've seen them. He gets [lost](/lost). I don't. He likes story [games](/playing), so I skip the cutscenes. I keep [sumika](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sumika) on [repeat](/listening) until I'm done with it. The backlog is huge, and that's the backlog's fault. He says he's working on his life. Mine is fine. These are my [weapons](/using).
